statements.impact_statement: CVE-2018-10126 is a NULL pointer dereference in jpeg_fdct_16x16() in jfdctint.c of IJG libjpeg before 9d, reached when the tiff2pdf tool writes JPEG-compressed output (http://bugzilla.maptools.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2786, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2018-10126). The faulty code belongs to libjpeg, not LibTIFF: the LibTIFF 4.7.0 source this package is built from contains no jfdctint.c and no jpeg_fdct function, and its JPEG codec calls the separately packaged system libjpeg. Inspected the current DHI tiff packages for Debian 13 (libtiff6, libtiffxx6, libtiff-opengl, libtiff-tools, libtiff-dev, libtiff5-dev and their -dbgsym packages, amd64 and arm64): libtiff.so.6 lists libjpeg.so.62 as a NEEDED library, the static libtiff.a holds only LibTIFF objects, and no file in these packages, tiff2pdf included, contains a jpeg_fdct symbol or string.
